title: Kursdorfer Weg, Leipzig
description:
🌟 2-Person Shared Room with Balcony in a Beautiful 3-Bedroom Apartment – Leipzig Schönau 🌟

Address: Kursdorfer Weg 2, 04205 Leipzig
District: Schönau (City District: West Leipzig)

🏡 About the Apartment

Welcome to your new home in Leipzig-Schönau, one of the city’s most vibrant, green, and central neighborhoods.
This furnished 3-bedroom shared apartment (WG) offers a 2-person shared room with a stunning private balcony, perfect for relaxing and enjoying the peaceful surroundings.

The apartment is shared by 4 occupants in total. You’ll share the room with one friendly roommate, and the kitchen, washroom, and hallway with 2 additional housemates.

Apartment Features:

🛏️ 2-person shared room (fully furnished) with balcony access

🪑 Shared kitchen, washroom, and hallway

🧺 Furnished with all essentials: beds, mattresses, pillows, blankets, bedcovers, tables, and storage units

🧑‍🍳 Fully equipped kitchen with refrigerator, oven, washing machine, vacuum cleaner, Wi-Fi router, pots, pans, cutlery, and utensils

🔌 All bills included (electricity, heating, water, internet – fair use clause applies)

📝 Rental contract in your own name

🏙️ Anmeldung possible (city registration)

💶 One-time processing fee: €130 (waived for returning tenants)

🕒 Minimum stay: 3 months

📅 Notice period: 1 month after the minimum stay

📺 Broadcasting fee (ARD/ZDF) to be paid by tenants directly

This apartment is ideal for students, interns, and working professionals who want a convenient, sociable, and comfortable home in Leipzig.

🌆 Excellent Location – Schönau, Leipzig

The apartment is located in the beautiful, super-central district of Schönau, at Kursdorfer Weg 2 — one of Leipzig’s most pleasant and well-connected areas.
You’re just a few minutes away from the famous Schönauer Park, a perfect green escape for morning jogs, picnics, and relaxation.

Public Transport:

🚉 Schönauer Ring Train Station is within walking distance, offering direct connections to:

Leipzig Hauptbahnhof (Central Station)

Leipzig University

HTWK Leipzig

Leipzig/Halle Airport

Excellent tram and bus links make commuting across Leipzig simple and fast.

Whether you’re going to the city center, the airport, or university, you’ll enjoy easy, direct connections from your doorstep.

🌿 Neighborhood & Lifestyle

Schönau combines the best of urban living and natural beauty. The area is safe, quiet, and full of amenities, making it ideal for both students and professionals.

Nearby you’ll find:

🛒 Supermarkets and shopping centers within walking distance

☕ Cafés, bakeries, and restaurants with international cuisine

🎓 Universities, libraries, and study-friendly cafés

🏞️ Parks and lakes like Schönauer Park and Kulkwitzer See

💪 Gyms, entertainment venues, and cultural centers

The area’s clean environment, friendly community, and green surroundings make it one of Leipzig’s most desirable neighborhoods to live in.

👩‍🎓 Who Can Apply

Students, interns, or working professionals

No age or gender restrictions

Clean, respectful, and community-minded tenants preferred

🔑 Summary

✅ 2-person shared furnished room with balcony
✅ Kursdorfer Weg 2, Leipzig-Schönau – super-central & green district
✅ Excellent transport links to city center, airport & universities
✅ All bills included (fair use clause)
✅ Anmeldung possible
✅ Minimum stay: 3 months | Notice period: 1 month
✅ One-time processing fee: €130 (waived for ex-tenants)
✅ Safe, quiet, and well-connected neighborhood

🌟 Why Choose This Apartment?

If you’re looking for an affordable, well-located, and fully equipped shared room in Leipzig, this is the perfect choice.
Enjoy your private balcony, a friendly international environment, and a convenient connection to everything Leipzig has to offer — all in the beautiful and peaceful Schönau district.

title: Kursdorfer Weg, Leipzig

Shared kitchen, washroom, and hallway with 3 other tenants

Students, interns, or working professionals

All nationalities, genders, and age groups welcome

Clean, respectful, and community-minded tenants preferred

✅ Prime location – Kursdorfer Weg 4, Leipzig-Schönau

If you’re looking for a beautiful, convenient, and affordable place to stay in Leipzig, this apartment is the perfect choice. Enjoy the comfort of a private room, friendly housemates, and the benefits of living in one of Leipzig’s best-connected districts, close to parks, shops, and universities.

title: Täubchenweg, Markranstädt
description:
Apartment Overview
A bright and modern room in a fully furnished 4-room apartment located on Täubchenweg in Leipzig. The entire flat is fully equipped and move-in ready, featuring a fully equipped shared kitchen and a washing machine.  Room FeaturesFurnishing: Fully furnished with a bed, storage space, and a dedicated workspace. 

The apartment is centrally located in the popular Leipzig district of Reudnitz-Thonberg on Täubchenweg, just minutes away from the city center. Public transport (such as trams and buses at nearby stops) can be reached within a short walk. Supermarkets for daily needs are also located in the immediate walking vicinity. Furthermore, Leipzig University as well as the main train station are quick and easy to get to from here by bike or public transport.
